# FR-1.1, speech is generated by kokoro

| ID | Requirement | |
|---|---|---|
| FR-1.1 | Speech is generated by **kokoro**. | [A] |

kokoro is installed in the project virtualenv and nowhere else, so it imports
under `.venv/bin/python` and not under the machine's `python3`.

    .venv/bin/python -c "import kokoro"

The model is named here and the language is not. FR-7.6 settles that separately,
and FR-1.13 carries the Python version skid runs kokoro under.
